title: Forfeited-Offer Credit in Dropped-Batch Disputes — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
A shopper who gave up a well-paid offer by dropping it, and was paid nothing for it, earns a forfeited-offer credit when disputing the dropped-batch violation on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts.

**Which batch.** The dropped batch is the batch named on the dropped-batch violation under dispute. The pay shown on its offer and the earnings it paid are read from its record in Cartwise Shopper Batches.

**Clause.** An offer of $20.00 or more on a batch that paid no earnings gives a forfeited-offer credit of 2 points; an offer from $10.00 up to but not including $20.00 on a batch that paid no earnings gives 1 point; any other case gives no credit.

## Truth table

| Pay shown on the offer | Earnings the batch paid | Forfeited-offer credit |
|---|---|---|
| $20.00 or more | None ($0.00) | 2 points |
| $10.00 to $19.99 | None ($0.00) | 1 point |
| Under $10.00 | None ($0.00) | None |
| Any amount | Any earnings above $0.00 | None |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical batches paying no earnings)

| Pay shown | Credit |
|---|---|
| $20.00 | 2 points |
| $19.99 | 1 point |
| $10.00 | 1 point |
| $9.99 | None |

A batch whose offer showed $24.00 but which paid $3.50 of earnings gives no credit: both conditions must hold together.
